data.narrative:
Neuralink is a private-stage AI & Software company that has raised $1.3B+ to date. The valuation universe for this sector includes 1 public comparable (Palantir Technologies, ticker PLTR) and 8 private peers, with the most relevant private benchmarks being Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

Standard peer-median triangulation is not applicable here due to insufficient narrow peer set density. Among the 12 same-sector peers identified, none satisfy the filters required for reliable median pricing (minimum three datapoints at same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier). Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias and is therefore inapplicable to Neuralink's specific positioning.

Without viable peer-median results, this analysis cannot triangulate to a supported valuation range using the data provided. Completion of this valuation would require either: expanded stage-adjacent or sector-adjacent comparable data; disclosed valuations from the identified private peer set (Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, Applied Intuition); or forward-looking revenue/margin assumptions tied to disclosed financial metrics. The primary uncertainty remains the absence of sufficient comps at equivalent stage and operational maturity to anchor quantitative pricing.
